title: Woman in Floral Dream Room
description: A blue-skinned woman with dark hair in a bun sits on a mustard-yellow sofa, gazing out a large window at a surreal sunset with Ferris wheels. The room features turquoise walls adorned with circular floral motifs, lush pink flowers growing indoors, a wooden coffee table with roses, and a retro teal cabinet with a lit lamp.
prompt: A serene blue-skinned woman with dark hair in a bun sits on a mustard sofa inside a dreamy room, looking out a large window at a vibrant red and teal sunset with distant Ferris wheels. The turquoise walls are covered in overlapping circular frames filled with stylized flowers and leaves, while large pink hibiscus and roses grow throughout the space. A wooden coffee table holds a vase of roses, and a retro teal cabinet with a warm lamp stands nearby. Surreal, whimsical, detailed painting style.
